purpose: EXE 可读的本地资源库；运行时数据、Harness 回执、报告和桌面会话写入此目录。
dataSeedPolicy: the main EXE carries the portable TQ formula source seed and merges it into the writable resource library; historical daily archives and public snapshots remain in the separate data-pack installer; do not copy duplicate historical full snapshots into the main EXE
dailyStoragePolicy: one canonical aggregate plus per-trade-date delta; daily full snapshots are not generated
minuteDataPolicy: external TDX .lc5 on demand; never bundled into EXE or resource-library; skills that declare minute features degrade when unavailable
